title: Removal surgeries attended; some implants looked like human microchips

tellings.quote: I attend I attended the last three removal surgeries including my own.

plain: A scientist named Steve Colbern, who studies what he calls alien implants, small objects some people believe were put in their bodies by aliens, says he attended the last three surgeries to remove them, including one on himself, and that some of the objects looked like human-made microchips. He tells Michels this firsthand and links the surgeries to a man named Roger Leir. If true, it would mean the implants are physical things that can be cut out and studied.
